paper_title: Continual Dialogue State Tracking via Reason-of-Select Distillation
caption: : Avg. JGA score at each turn
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average JGA (Joint Goal Accuracy) score for two models—LLaMA-7B (represented by orange bars) and T5-small (represented by yellow bars)—across successive turns, labeled as Turn ID from 0 to 26 on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled "Avg. JGA Score," ranges from 0.2 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1, using a linear scale. For each Turn ID, the two models are compared side-by-side, with LLaMA-7B consistently achieving higher JGA scores than T5-small across all turns. At Turn ID 0, both models attain their highest scores, approximately 0.95 for LLaMA-7B and 0.9 for T5-small. As Turn ID increases, both models show a gradual decline in JGA scores, with LLaMA-7B maintaining a stable but decreasing trend, ending at approximately 0.45 at Turn ID 26, while T5-small drops more steeply, reaching approximately 0.35 at Turn ID 26. The bars are arranged in ascending order of Turn ID along the x-axis, and no visual emphasis (such as shading or annotations) is applied to any specific bar. The legend in the upper right corner clearly distinguishes the two models by color.
